channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Meta suspends plan to issue new shares to Mark Zuckerberg amid Delaware lawsuit: Why investors are challenging the deal
item.description: Meta has paused its plan to issue non-voting Class C shares to Mark Zuckerberg amid an investor lawsuit. The proposal would allow him to sell up to half of his stake over time without losing control of the social media giant.

item.title: Anthropic raised $81 billion in IPO despite $104 billion loss: Why Wall Street is betting big on Claude
item.description: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO, pricing shares at $83 and selling more shares than planned. Revenue surged as Claude Code gained popularity, but the company reported a $104 billion net loss.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Let's move forward': Nvidia interim CEO Kress announces pay raises at first all-hands meeting since Huang's exit
item.description: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress urged employees to move forward at the company's first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang's resignation, announcing pay raises as calls for the former chief's return grow despite the board ruling out his reinstatement.

item.title: Allana bets on meat-sourcing edge to crack India's pet-food market
item.description: The 116-year-old B2B meat exporter is building consumer brands Bowlers and Purrfeto, leveraging its processing network as FMCG companies intensify competition in the pet-food market.

item.title: Style Union parent Nexon raises ₹485 crore from Venturi, Elev8 Venture
item.description: The deal values the fashion retail chain at about ₹8,000 crore, a person with knowledge of the matter said.

item.title: In GCC race, Cognizant bets on reskilling talent, Infosys on rewiring legacy tech
item.description: Separated by less than $1 billion in annual revenue, the two IT rivals are taking sharply different routes to win over global capability centres—a bet that could break the deadlock between them.

item.title: Wise CEO questions RBI’s ₹25 lakh cap on cross-border fintech payments
item.description: Kristo Käärmann says the limit makes it harder for Indian exporters to bring money home, even as Wise moves $15 billion, or about 10% of India’s inward remittances, into the country

item.title: In growth push, Howden eyes insurance broker buyouts in India
item.description: Having taken full ownership of its Indian arm, Howden could consider acquisitions that add expertise and capabilities and not just scale, joining a growing list of global firms eyeing a bigger slice of India's insurance pie.

item.title: What lurks beneath India's strong quarterly earnings
item.description: Adjusted net profit of 3,835 companies rose 30% in Q2FY27, the fastest growth in three years, a Mint analysis showed. But rising input costs and limited pricing power could weigh on margins in the second half.

item.title: US judge rejects JPMorgan bid to dismiss lurid sexual harassment case
item.description: JPMORGAN

item.title: Sell-Side Analysts Rip Short-Seller Report on Retailer Dynamite
item.description: Several financial analysts fended off a negative report from short-seller Spruce Point Capital Management LLC about fast-fashion retailer Groupe Dynamite Inc.

item.title: Explained | All about the Cambay offshore block at the centre of Vedanta chair Anil Agarwal's tiff with the govt
item.description: Vedanta chairman Anil Agarwal has criticised the Centre's decision to transfer its producing Cambay offshore oil and gas block to ONGC, calling it a wrong signal to investors.

item.title: Intel layoffs: Fresh job cuts hit chipmaker, workforce falls to 81,100 as Lip-Bu Tan steps up restructuring
item.description: Intel has announced fresh job cuts as CEO Lip-Bu Tan pushes ahead with restructuring. The chipmaker's workforce has fallen to 81,100 amid mounting business challenges.

item.title: Meet Amruda Nair, granddaughter of The Leela founder Captain CP Krishnan Nair who launched Araiya Hotels & Resorts
item.description: Amruda Nair founded Araiya Hotels &amp; Resorts in 2018, focusing on destination-led luxury and experiences. The company aims to reach 40 hotels over the next five years, she revealed in a new interview with Hotelier India.

item.title: ACME takes final investment decision on $3.6 billion Odisha green ammonia project
item.description: The 760,000-tonne facility, expected to be commissioned by 2029, will supply green ammonia to buyers in India and Japan, with Brookfield committing $600 million to ACME’s green molecule business.

item.title: How ONGC took over the Cambay block it co-owned with Vedanta; why Anil Agarwal is objecting? Explained
item.description: Why did ONGC take over the Cambay offshore block from Vedanta? Here's how the dispute began, what Anil Agarwal objected to and where the legal battle stands.

item.title: Nvidia’s ‘selective’ funding: Could interim CEO Colette Kress’s 'disciplined' approach slow neocloud boom? Explained
item.description: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress has pledged selective funding for neoclouds and AI startups. Could the move reshape the industry's growth?

item.title: Who is Pragya Misra? OpenAI elevates its first India employee to lead business development across South Asia
item.description: OpenAI’s head of Strategy and Global Affairs to lead commercial partnerships in India and South Asia, as the AI company expands its presence in the region.

item.title: Nvidia power shift: Colette Kress, Madison Huang and the battle over Jensen Huang's legacy
item.description: Nvidia's leadership transition has brought renewed attention to the relationship between interim CEO Colette Kress and Madison Huang, daughter of former CEO Jensen Huang. Kress had questioned financing and investment deals linked to Madison and Nico Caprez, even before Huang stepped down.

item.title: Air India Express bets on Rajawat to turn growth into profits
item.description: Air India Express's earlier CEO, Aloke Singh, left in March, and the budget carrier then appointed Captain Hamish Maxwell, the airline's chief operating officer, as its ‘accountable manager’

item.title: Bombay HC quashes ICICI Bank’s sanction to prosecute ex-CEO Chanda Kochhar in Videocon loan case: What the court said
item.description: The Bombay HC quashed ICICI Bank's sanction to prosecute former CEO Chanda Kochhar in the ₹3,250 crore Videocon loan case, ruling that the authority granting approval was incompetent and had failed to apply its mind to the material before it.

item.title: Salesforce hit by fresh layoffs: Employees report bosses and colleagues losing jobs - What we know
item.description: Salesforce has reportedly begun another round of layoffs, with a senior manager, team members and employees' bosses among those affected. Here's what we know.

item.title: Samsung reclaims India’s smartphone crown as iPhone shipments tumble 25%: What went wrong for Apple?
item.description: Apple’s iPhone shipments in India reportedly fell 25% year-over-year to about 3.7 million in the July–September 2026 quarter, dropping the company to fourth place. Samsung reclaimed market leadership, becoming the only top-10 brand to grow shipments amid a broader slowdown.

item.title: Fractal Analytics eyes 20-25 startups in healthcare, AI engineering and agentic AI: What's driving the acquisition push?
item.description: Fractal Analytics is in talks with 20-25 startups for acquisitions across healthcare, agentic AI and engineering. Here's what the company hopes to gain.

item.title: Qualcomm India restructuring job losses: CEO says layoffs ‘performance-based’, but 47% of employees allege favouritism
item.description: Qualcomm CEO linked the impending job cuts directly to performance standards following annual reviews, as well as to business priorities and the capabilities required for future growth.

item.title: India to have adequate coking coal as Europe, US move away from blast furnaces: Naveen Jindal
item.description: The industry must continue investing in overseas coal assets to secure supplies, advises Naveen Jindal, chairman, Jindal Steel Ltd

item.title: Who is Deepak Rajawat? Former Vistara executive appointed Air India Express CEO amid ambitious fleet expansion plans
item.description: Air India Express has appointed Deepak Rajawat, its current finance chief, as the budget carrier's chief executive officer.

item.title: Krishna Reddy raises ₹7,000 crore to buy out uncle PP Reddy’s stake in Megha Engineering: Report
item.description: MEIL managing director PV Krishna Reddy has reportedly raised about ₹7,000 crore from global investors, led by Davidson Kempner, to buy his uncle PP Reddy’s stake. The financing supports a family settlement that could value the controlling stake at ₹12,000–15,000 crore.

item.title: Nvidia hires Heidrick & Struggles as it intensifies search for next CEO | All you need to know about firm
item.description: Nvidia has hired executive search firm Heidrick &amp; Struggles to find its next CEO following Jensen Huang's resignation. The firm has previously helped major companies appoint leaders, including Google's Eric Schmidt, Microsoft's Satya Nadella and Freddie Mac's Charles Haldeman Jr.

item.title: Doors shut on Jensen Huang: Where are the other Nvidia co-founders, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, now?
item.description: Nvidia’s three co-founders built the company after meeting at a Denny’s in East San Jose. Jensen Huang became its longtime public face, while Chris Malachowsky remains a senior technical leader. Curtis Priem retired in 2003, later donating most of his Nvidia fortune to his alma mater.

item.title: Tata Steel's 40 mtpa domestic capacity target slips by upto five years
item.description: The steelmaker expects to reach its domestic capacity target three to five years late, while seeking government support to fund its green steel transition in the Netherlands.

item.title: Cognizant beats TCS, HCLTech: Tech giant bags seven-year contract worth ₹16,313 crore from UK’s Network Rail | Details
item.description: Cognizant has been selected for a seven-year Network Rail contract worth £132.2 million, beating TCS, HCLTech and two global rivals. The deal adds to the IT services major’s recent UK wins amid steady revenue growth in the region.

item.title: Boutique firms take on McKinsey, BCG and the Big Four in B-school hiring
item.description: Consulting is drawing 35-40% of management graduates, and boutique firms &nbsp;are now directly challenging giants like BCG, Bain and the Big Four on campus. B-schools expect the rivalry to intensify further as AI reshapes junior consulting roles.

item.title: ‘Very wrong signal to investors’: Anil Agarwal on transfer of Vedanta’s oil and gas block in Gujarat to ONGC
item.description: Vedanta Chairman Anil Agarwal said transferring the producing Cambay offshore block to ONGC could undermine investor confidence. The transfer followed the government’s rejection of a contract extension; Vedanta’s legal challenge is awaiting a Delhi HC division bench judgment.

item.title: BHIM prioritizes user growth over a fight with PhonePe, Google Pay
item.description: Lalitha Nataraj, MD and CEO of NBSL, says BHIM's success should be measured by the active users it retains and the first-time users it brings into the UPI ecosystem.
